head.t: RESET-AF 3D study reveals positive six-month outcomes with Biotronik’s investigational PFA system
head.x: Biotronik today announced the completion of six-month clinical outcomes from the RESET-AF 3D study evaluating its investigational ElePulse pulsed field ablation (PFA) system in patients with symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF).
